summary: Frontend-only verification of (a) new venue-preset chip in /dashboard.html sidebar and (b) bug fix making the Plug-in 'Configure' button work in /setup_walk_mockup.html. All 8 scenarios from the review request PASSED.

tests_executed.T1_default_render_chip_CUSTOM_40_60: PASS — chip label 'CUSTOM', range '40-60%', slider icon 🎚, title 'Custom RH band (40-60% RH) — click to pick a venue preset'.
tests_executed.T2_museum_hydration_via_localStorage: PASS — chip label 'MUSEUM', icon '🏛', range '40-55%', title 'Venue preset: Museum (40-55% RH) — click to change in setup walk'.
tests_executed.T3_live_tracking_non_preset_drops_to_CUS: PASS — with red5_rh_preset=museum but red5_sweet_spot_range=35-65, chip correctly drops to 'CUSTOM 35-65%' because lo/hi don't match the preset.
tests_executed.T3b_exact_match_fallback_no_localStorage: PASS (extra) — clearing red5_rh_preset and setting range to 30-60 resolves to 'OFFICE' (first preset row matching lo/hi exactly).
tests_executed.T4_chip_click_navigates_to_setup_walk: PASS — clicking chip changes location to /setup_walk_mockup.html.
tests_executed.T5_weather_configure_expands_panel: PASS — button text 'Configure ▾' → 'Close ▴'; panel data-testid='plugin-config-panel-weather' appears with Provider select (Open-Meteo/NWS/ECMWF), Refresh interval select, Cache TTL number input default 30, plus Reset defaults and Done buttons. Done collapses the panel and restores button text.
tests_executed.T6_dibt_plugin_specific_fields: PASS — DIBT panel shows 3 fields: Bridge host (text, default '192.168.1.100'), Telegram port (number, default 47808), Poll interval (ms) (number, default 2000).
tests_executed.T7_reset_defaults_weather: PASS — changing Provider to 'NWS' then clicking 'Reset defaults' restores 'Open-Meteo'.
tests_executed.REG_existing_sidebar_icons: PASS — standards-btn, collector-config-btn, reset-modal-sizes-btn all present and clickable; new chip does not interfere.

critical_code_review_comments: sidebar.js L60-65: localStorage.getItem('red5_rh_preset') only honoured if the preset's lo/hi match the live sweetSpotRange, which is the correct design described in the agent-to-agent context note. Fallback to first-matching VENUE_PRESETS row works as documented (verified by 30-60 → OFFICE test).
setup_walk_mockup.html L854-882 PLUGIN_CONFIG_FIELDS: only 4 plug-ins have ≥3 fields; 'sweet_spot' has just 2 fields. Per-plugin variation verified against DIBT spec.
Minor non-blocking console noise: cdn.tailwindcss.com prod warning, 401 from /api/services and /Inline Babel 500KB transformer warning. Pre-existing — unrelated to this iteration's changes.

Both dashboard.html and setup_walk_mockup.html serve from /app/frontend/public via the preview URL successfully. Mirror copies in /app/archive/Red5-Studio-V1.9 and V2.0 noted in PRD but not retested (byte-identical per md5sum).
seed_data_creation: Used localStorage keys red5_sweet_spot_range and red5_rh_preset to drive chip state — no persistent backend writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Venue preset chip and plug-in Configure fix verified end-to-end via Playwright. data-testid selectors used: venue-preset-chip, venue-preset-chip-label, plugin-config-<id>, plugin-config-panel-<id>, plugin-toggle-<id>. To drive chip state in tests, set localStorage['red5_sweet_spot_range']='{"lo":..,"hi":..}' and optionally localStorage['red5_rh_preset']=<id>, then reload — sidebar reads these on App mount. Use wait_until='domcontentloaded' instead of 'networkidle' for /dashboard.html (background telemetry polling never goes idle).
